prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Card Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout showcasing the companion visual preview on one side and key feature highlights on the other.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pre-made pet or create a custom friend to keep you company on your desktop."}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Email Reminder Hint: Add a clear explanatory hint under the sign-in options reminding users to sign in with their existing account to restore saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use the email from your existing account to instantly restore your saved pets and progress."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection component in pick_friend into a structured visual grid layout.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Your Pet Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}}
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Status Hint: Display status hint text and dynamic progress indicators on the photo upload screen during pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Processing high-resolution photo... Ensuring pet features are generated accurately.", "show_progress": true}}
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Sound: Trigger a notification chime sound on the waiting screen once desktop initialization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:chime", "style": "calm", "action": "play"}]}}
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Shortcut Controls Overview Screen: Add a new sub-flow screen 'new_controls_overview' before home intro introducing essential keyboard shortcuts and desktop visibility controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_overview", "home_intro"], "new_controls_overview": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Learn simple shortcuts to summon, minimize, or interact with your pet anytime on your desktop."}}
6: [choose_path, reorder] Story Screen Immediate Path Highlight Reorder: Add direct choice components to the story screen to fast-track path selection.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Your Path", "style": "emphasis", "action": "choose"}]}}
7: [finish, new_screen] Onboarding Celebration Reward Screen: Insert a new celebratory screen 'new_completion_reward' at the end of onboarding to confirm setup is complete.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_completion_reward"], "new_completion_reward": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Enjoy your new companion!"}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Badge: Add a celebratory mascot badge element to the adoption certificate screen to increase emotional attachment.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:happy_pet", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Value Proposition Copy Update: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize cross-device cloud sync and pet data security.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Cloud Save", "body": "Sign in to keep your pet settings, customizations, and progress safe across all your computers."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns story screen layout while preserving its core function of introducing the pet.
Adds helpful sign-in account hint without violating any base rules.
Redesigns pet selection into a grid layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Adds photo processing status hint and dynamic progress indicator on upload_photos screen.
Triggers sound notification chime on waiting screen when pet generation finishes.
Adds a valid new controls overview sub-flow screen before home_intro without removing existing steps.
Adding direct path selection to the story screen fast-tracks selection and makes the choose_path step skippable.
Adds a valid new completion reward screen after home_intro within onboarding bounds.
Replaces adoption certificate components with a mascot badge, removing the required official stamp.
Updates sign-in copy to highlight cloud save functionality without violating pricing or data rules.
